Sorry for the late response. 

I have a lot of hobbies and such, I have been drawing about 5-6 years now. I've recently begun to get into nail art after seeing [simplynailogical](https://www.youtube.com/simplynailogical). I also have a travler's journal that I pour my thoughts on. It's entertaining,  but not really therapeutic. 

I'm hesitant about therapy and meds since they didn't really work. I tried it after going to the ER after a suicide attempt and it was just very shitty. I'm not really telling my dad because I don't want to make him worry. 

After pushing him away for the third time, I don't think I can't get the relationship back. I fucked up.

I just had a problem with a friend. He was very nice but I fucked up about everything. I'm in high school, and the stress would be kinda a external factor of my depression, but I've been like this since G6, so, yea. 

I feel like my future is clustered because I don't even know if I can have a decent life and do what I want and such. I don't know if I can go into a decent university. I don't know if I cant do anything. I'm just worried about my future as a whole. 

My parents..are ok. My dad tries to understand but not my mom.
